note: Wikimedia Commons, “Fresco of Stefan Vladislav, Mileševa.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Meister von Mileseva — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons files it under “Stefan Vladislav” and “Frescos in Mileševa Monastery”, with the artist recorded as the Master of Mileševa and the subject as a 13th-century figure. Stefan Vladislav I, king of Serbia and the founder of Mileševa, is this folder's «Св. краљ Владислав»; the fresco is his donor portrait in his own foundation, not the later Stefan Vladislav II, who built nothing there.
